cohort: The study included 6090 pregnant women from five cities in Iran, whose data was collected between September 2016 and January 2019.
finding: This study found no statistically significant association between exposure to various air pollutants (O3, NO, NO2, NOx, SO2, CO, PM2.5, PM10) and the risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) before and during different trimesters of pregnancy.
